title: Task Information Delivery Plan (TIDP)

scope.purpose: Define discipline/task-team commitments that produce the information deliverables aggregated by the MIDP.

requirements.statement: Every TIDP task shall explicitly reference a valid MIDP deliverable ID.
Discipline task leads shall submit updated TIDP progress prior to each weekly coordination cycle.
Task milestones may be re-baselined only with written approval from the Project BIM Manager.

runtime_note: The L4 TIDP standard governs required fields and relationships. Runtime TIDP records in the BEP delivery engine are downstream implementation data.

provenance.migration_note: Standalone L4 S2 production standard linked to canonical MIDP requirements.
